ambiguities.text: Nodes should dynamically adjust custody following validator balance changes - unclear how quickly adjustments must occur
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume custody adjustments happen at epoch boundaries when effective balance is recalculated. This is an assumption based on how effective balance updates work.

ambiguities.text: Persist highest custody requirement across restarts - no specification of how long this persistence must last or when it can be lowered
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the highest custody requirement persists indefinitely until the node explicitly recalculates based on current validator set. This prevents custody gaps during restarts.

implicit_assumptions.description: The network has sufficient total custody coverage across all nodes to ensure every column is custodied by multiple peers
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Some columns may have no custodians, making data availability verification impossible for those columns

implicit_assumptions.description: Validators have sufficient storage and bandwidth to custody their required number of groups (minimum 8) per slot
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Validators unable to meet custody requirements would degrade network data availability guarantees

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution engine correctly provides cell-based proofs via engine_getPayloadV5 that are consistent with the blob commitments
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Invalid cell proofs would cause column sidecar verification failures, potentially preventing block acceptance
